turn_overrides.T1: Among male patients with an available workbook, use BLM carrier to include both Phenotype=Carrier and Phenotype=Affected records. Identify the oldest eligible patient.
turn_overrides.T2: Use non-reference to mean only Heterozygous records.
turn_overrides.T3: Use `Gene Names category` to mean each individual symbol after splitting commas and semicolons.

human_repair_overrides.content: Define a BLM carrier as an eligible male older than 50 years with an available workbook, which selects P556.
Treat the full visible 133-row non-reference frequency table as Heterozygous-only.
Before counting categories in that table, split every compound Gene Names entry at commas and semicolons and count the resulting individual symbols.
